def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    other = 1 - player_id
    captured = state_view.captured
    board = state_view.board
    lead = captured[player_id] - captured[other]
    pool = captured[player_id] + captured[other]
    own = sum(board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6])
    opp = sum(board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6])
    balance = (own - opp) / (1 + own + opp)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, 8.0 * lead / (1 + pool) + 0.8 * balance))

def evaluate_state(state_view, player_id):
    other = 1 - player_id
    captured = state_view.captured
    board = state_view.board
    own_board = sum(board[player_id * 6:player_id * 6 + 6])
    opp_board = sum(board[other * 6:other * 6 + 6])
    own_total = captured[player_id] + own_board
    opp_total = captured[other] + opp_board
    all_seeds = own_total + opp_total
    captured_share = (captured[player_id] - captured[other]) / (1 + all_seeds)
    endgame_weight = 1 + (48 - min(48, own_board + opp_board)) / 48.0
    board_balance = (own_board - opp_board) / (1 + own_board + opp_board)
    return max(-10.0, min(10.0, 9.0 * captured_share + 0.7 * endgame_weight * board_balance))
